messages.author: Benny Swiftfoot
messages.text: Nah.... I will stick with my Retroid Pocket 6 and Switch 2 than. Whatever streaming box they will try to force on us;  Nah...

messages.author: Benny Swiftfoot
messages.text: 3 years from now, I will probably still be playing Rock Band 3 on Xbox 360. Pokopia, DK Bananza etc... . Not to mention all the GameCube games I want on Retroid.

messages.author: Benny Swiftfoot
messages.text: Does the blame shift more towards Cold Iron Studios than Nintendo when it comes to people losing access to a game because the cloud server is shut down?

messages.author: Benny Swiftfoot
messages.text: I would never buy a cloud based Switch game, but I would think the people who make the game should be the main ones to blame. Hope to see Cold Iron Studios get a boycott. They should shut down their business
